title: Invasion steps: bombardment, Space Cannon Defense and result toasts
description: The bombardment and Space Cannon Defense steps of a planet invasion in the invasion panel, with unit names, planet names, player names, dice and hit thresholds instead of raw ids, and three corner toasts: bombardment result, Space Cannon Defense result and the invasion summary. Before shots were taken with TI4_SHOT_PREFIX=before on the base commit (7f922896); npm run screenshots -- BW regenerates the after shots. Fixtures are synthetic invasion states through the mocked server; seat ids are long participant ids as the engine sends them.

shots.heading: Bombardment target, desktop: before
shots.caption: Two players have ground forces on Jord; the invader must pick whose forces take 2 bombardment hits. Two bare buttons named after the seat; nothing says who fires, how many hits, or what each answer puts at risk.

shots.heading: Bombardment target, desktop: after
shots.caption: An offer card: titled Bombardment hits, step 1 of the invasion, the planet, who bombards, hits to assign, an explanation (ground forces only, a Mech may sustain damage) and one button per player naming their forces on the planet.

notes.title: Engine change
notes.text: The bombardment target decision now carries display-only offer-card details (planet, bombarding seat, hits, per-player forces). Option ids, order and kinds are unchanged; details stay out of decision records and fingerprints.

notes.title: Toast limits
notes.text: Toasts are derived from the board's last invasion step, so a step that the engine never records (no dice rolled, e.g. the planet is shielded or nobody can bombard) raises none. Steps already visible when the page loads, or after an undo, do not toast.
